limits: Original year-1/year-2/year-3/opening-4 source files unavailable; all new cases are small, explicitly identified samples. No extrapolated 229.5MB compression/dedup ratios.
Attribution of the original three years and proving the 115MB target remain blocked on hash-verified sources.
No production storage code, save version, gameplay schema, CAS or IndexedDB behavior changed.
Codec timings exclude disk/IndexedDB transactions. Control input validation, clone and equality verification are reported separately from restore path.

Brotli q4 uses a 4MiB window vs Gzip 32KiB; these small pairs can fit cross-root repeats in the Brotli window. Large-checkpoint cross-root distances may exceed either window. No large-file ratio inferred. Codec bytes exclude any as-yet-undesigned S2 physical envelope.

decision.provisionalS2: Gzip binary envelope at storage adapter boundary; retain full v1 payload and validators, no prefix sharing in first implementation. Version the physical envelope, dual-read legacy v1 text, keep v1 manual export initially.
decision.finalLargeSaveDecision: BLOCKED: obtain hash-verified actual year-3 checkpoint, validate and compare JSON/Gzip/Brotli with bounded CPU/memory before committing target/phone claims.
decision.reason: Small-case prefix savings are limited, combined Gzip differences negligible or negative, extra copies/verification increase observed memory and restore costs; modern native Brotli is available but the Web Streams default trade-off and older Safari fallback add complexity.
